class.name: Wheel
class.brief_description: A simulated vehicle wheel with suspension raycasting.
class.description: Wheel is a [Node3D] that represents a single wheel of a vehicle. It creates and manages a [RayCast3D] child node for suspension simulation. The wheel computes suspension forces based on spring stiffness, damping, and the detected collision point. It is typically used as a child of an [Axle] node.

method.name: get_suspension_rebound_force
method.description: Returns the current suspension rebound force in Newtons, calculated from the spring compression and damper velocity.
